title: Synthesis and antibacterial activity study of anti-biofilm agents based on American oyster defensin analog A4
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21655-21666
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02550A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xin Zhang, Yu Liu, Zhixing Geng, Ye Guo
A potent anti-biofilm agent is developed by substituting L-amino acids with D-amino acids in A4. This novel anti-biofilm agent exhibits excellent stability and low toxicity, making it highly promising against bacterial infections.
